newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - September 5.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - September 5.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

The Home (interior) Ministry is working on setting up a special police force to combat terrorism in the country. The 2,000-man Rapid Action Force will be equipped with sophisticated arms, modern equipment and helicopters.
Nine people were killed and dozens other injured when two passenger buses collided head on in Northern district of Rangpur early on Wednesday.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina has vowed to wipe out terrorism from the country. Hasina said on Wednesday the government would not spare even her own partymen if "they are terrorists".
Bangladesh will strengthen its coast guard to prevent piracy in its sea water, Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina said.
World Bank is planning to include private sector representatives in future annual aid consultations with Bangladesh.
Bangladesh will set up a 210-megawatt gas-based power plant in the coastal district of Bhola where local engineers have recently discovered huge reserves of natural gas.
